title: Finite intrinsic tensor realization
statement: There exists a family of isomorphisms e identifying finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor with evaluatedTensor on every SixFunctorSpace.

source.place: Compatibility of the specified maps under successive coefficient reductions; integral reconstruction and proper counit normalization

proof.text: Apply the pointwise finite intrinsic-to-fixed tensor comparison at each SixFunctorSpace and assemble the chosen components into the required family.

proof_origin.place: Assembly of the pointwise intrinsic tensor comparisons into the specified family

from.place: Strictly smaller component of parent proof

lean.statement:
theorem finiteIntrinsicTensorRealization
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (m : ℕ)
    (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m)) :
    Nonempty (∀ X : SixFunctorSpace D,
        finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor C.l E X.obj.left m ≅
          evaluatedTensor (C := C) (E := E) m X)
